subject: Redwood Eval kickoff — next steps & scheduling
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Eval kickoff — next steps & scheduling

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand Acme's priorities for search relevancy and cost-per-request. Quick recap from our discovery:
- Primary goal: improve relevancy for product search across web + mobile (target uplift > 8% MAP)
- Success metrics: relevance delta on the evaluation prompt set, latency < 250ms p95, cost target ~40% lower than current infra
- Data constraints: cannot send PII, sample dataset ~50k queries, internal prompts and expected outputs available

Next step: we'd love to run a scoped evaluation (3-week trial) to validate model quality and perf. Can we schedule a 60–75 minute kickoff to align on the trial plan, success criteria, and the prompt set/evals? Proposed times (PT):
- Wed, Jun 3: 10:00–11:15 or 14:00–15:15
- Thu, Jun 4: 09:00–10:15 or 13:00–14:15

I've attached a short evaluation plan (redwood-eval-plan.pdf) that outlines the trial timeline and what we'll need from your side. If you prefer, I can send a calendar invite once you confirm a slot.

When you confirm, please include anyone from your team who will own evaluation acceptance (e.g., engineering lead / data owner). Also cc'd Mateo (SE) and Lauren (CS) — they'll lead the technical deep dive and success criteria alignment.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: redwood-eval-plan.pdf

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Wed Jun 3 10:00 PT works for me. I'll loop in our Engineering Manager (Sara Liu) and Product Lead (Ravi Patel) — they'll join the kickoff.

- Our preferred metric is MAP@10 and human evaluation for a small set (100 queries).

Perfect — thanks Sam. Wed 6/3 at 10:00 PT is locked. I'll send a calendar invite in a minute.

Agenda for the kickoff (60–75 min):
1) Introductions & objectives (5–10m)
2) Trial scope & timeline (10–15m) — what success looks like
3) Technical deep-dive (30m) — sample data, prompt formats, access patterns, latency expectations (Mateo to lead)
4) Evaluation plan & prompt set (10m) — how we'll run MAP/human evals, deliverables (Lauren to lead)
5) Next steps & owners (5m)

Mateo: can you confirm you'll cover model variants to test (quantized vs fp16), integration constraints for prefix caching, and what we'll need from Acme to run the trial?

Lauren: we'll want to align on acceptance criteria and reporting cadence — can you share the eval template (prompt-set-template.csv) during the call?

Sam — attaching the evaluation plan again for reference. If anyone else from Acme wants to join (Sara/Ravi), please add them to the invite.

Thanks,
Marissa
